capabilities.summary: A 2D camera maps a world point through position, clockwise rotation, and zoom.
restrictions: Zoom is finite and greater than 0. The only fit is contain.
conformanceTests: packages/schema/src/contract.test.ts#maps the specification camera example to (1040, 360)
packages/runtime/src/runtime.test.ts#maps the specification camera point and leaves screen space alone

lottie.scope: Lottie camera layers are not covered by a conformance test.

svg.scope: SVG has no camera.

capabilities.summary: The logical viewport is letterboxed and never stretched.
restrictions: contain is the only fit.
conformanceTests: packages/schema/src/contract.test.ts#letterboxes instead of stretching
packages/canvas-renderer/src/renderer.test.ts#letterboxes the logical viewport and clears the bars

lottie.scope: Imported viewports are not asserted against contain letterboxing.

svg.scope: preserveAspectRatio none is a separate SVG case and is not this claim.

capabilities.summary: Rectangle, circle, ellipse, line, and polygon use the 0.1 local geometry rules.
restrictions: Rectangle origin is the top-left. Ellipse and circle are centred.
conformanceTests: packages/compiler/src/compiler.test.ts#lowers a header, a constant, every primitive, and a nested group
packages/canvas-renderer/src/renderer.test.ts#starts rectangles at the local top-left and centres ellipses

lottie.scope: Static shape fixtures whose geometry is a centred rect or ellipse, including rectangle centre mapped to the IR top-left.
conformanceTests: packages/format-lottie/src/lottie.test.ts#maps Lottie rectangle centre to Scene IR top-left

svg.scope: Static rect, circle, ellipse, line, and polygon elements in the static primitives fixture.
conformanceTests: packages/format-svg/src/svg.test.ts#imports static primitives into validated Scene IR

capabilities.summary: Absolute move, line, quadratic, cubic, and close commands.
restrictions: Commands are absolute. The first command is move.
conformanceTests: packages/runtime/src/streaming.test.ts#keeps the sample on the quadratic the path draws

lottie.scope: Static path lowering has no conformance test that pins commands.

svg.scope: Elliptical arc commands are lowered to cubics. The cubic is not claimed identical to the SVG arc.
conformanceTests: packages/format-svg/src/svg.test.ts#lowers arcs to cubics and round-trips the static scene

capabilities.summary: One line of text with a builtin font, alignment, and baseline.
restrictions: One line. No tspan, textPath, or text animators. Glyph advance depends on the font.
conformanceTests: packages/compiler/src/compiler.test.ts#lowers a header, a constant, every primitive, and a nested group
packages/canvas-renderer/src/renderer.test.ts#draws text from its anchor with the requested alignment

lottie.scope: A text layer with document text can be lowered, but no conformance test pins the string.

svg.scope: A single text element's string is kept. Font metrics are not claimed to match the reference.
conformanceTests: packages/format-svg/src/svg.test.ts#marks simple text as approximated and keeps the string

capabilities.summary: linear, easeIn, easeOut, and easeInOut.
restrictions: These four names are the whole 0.1 easing set.
conformanceTests: packages/schema/src/contract.test.ts#matches the four V1 curves at one half
packages/runtime/src/runtime.test.ts#matches the four curves at a quarter and a half

lottie.scope: Named Bodymovin shortcuts are stored as these names, without a dedicated curve assertion.

svg.scope: SVG calcMode and keySplines are not mapped onto named easing.

capabilities.summary: Keyframe tracks sample between boundaries and hold the end fill.
restrictions: Overlapping writers of one channel are rejected. Samples do not replace the authored base.
conformanceTests: packages/runtime/src/runtime.test.ts#hits every keyframe boundary and the segment midpoints

lottie.scope: Scalar and split position tracks on a layer transform, in milliseconds from the composition in-point.
conformanceTests: packages/format-lottie/src/lottie.test.ts#animates position in milliseconds

svg.scope: SMIL and CSS coverage is recorded on svg.smilTimeBased and svg.cssKeyframes.

capabilities.summary: A step sets node visibility at a time.
restrictions: V1 steps write only node visibility. A child step cannot reveal a hidden ancestor.
conformanceTests: packages/runtime/src/runtime.test.ts#hides a subtree with a step and does not let a child step reveal it

lottie.scope: In and out points become visibility steps, without a conformance assertion of the step times.

svg.scope: The SVG subset does not lower visibility steps.

capabilities.summary: A bounded expression track samples after its start.
restrictions: Depth and operation budgets apply. An expression is not evaluated before the track starts.
conformanceTests: packages/runtime/src/runtime.test.ts#does not evaluate an expression before its track starts

lottie.scope: Lottie expressions are not imported. No conformance test pins that diagnostic.

svg.scope: Scripts and event handlers produce no scene.
conformanceTests: packages/format-svg/src/svg.test.ts#rejects scripts and event handlers with no scene

capabilities.summary: Drawn opacity is the product of the node and its ancestors.

packages/canvas-renderer/src/renderer.test.ts#paints in array order and uses each item's own opacity

svg.scope: Element opacity is lowered. Group isolation is compositing.isolatedOpacity.

capabilities.summary: A 0.2 consumer loads a 0.1 scene without changing its samples.
restrictions: Migration adds an identity root scope and empty 0.2 collections. It does not invent isolation or additive tracks.

lottie.scope: Migration is a reader of existing IR, not an import.

svg.scope: Migration is a reader of existing IR, not an import.

capabilities.summary: A timing scope shifts and stretches local track time.
restrictions: Stretch is finite and non-zero. Local time is (parent - offsetMs) / stretch.
conformanceTests: packages/compiler/src/compiler.test.ts#compiles compositions, instances, scopes, and cubic easing
packages/runtime/src/runtime.test.ts#applies cubic overshoot, hold, per-component easing, scopes, and composition order

conformanceTests: packages/format-lottie/src/lottie.test.ts#inventories omitted constructs before lowering

svg.scope: SVG time is baked into root tracks. Local scopes are not asserted.

capabilities.summary: Cubic easing solves x for progress, then returns y. Y may leave 0..1.
restrictions: X controls must lie in [0, 1].

packages/compiler/src/compiler.test.ts#compiles compositions, instances, scopes, and cubic easing
packages/runtime/src/runtime.test.ts#applies cubic overshoot, hold, per-component easing, scopes, and composition order

conformanceTests: packages/format-lottie/src/dataset.test.ts#repeats hashes and never labels a known loss as exact

svg.scope: SVG keySplines are not stored as cubic easing.

capabilities.summary: Hold easing stays on the segment start until the next key.
restrictions: Hold is a key easing, not a baked pair of micro-keys.
conformanceTests: packages/schema/src/capability-02.test.ts#solves cubic y after x and keeps hold on the segment start
packages/runtime/src/runtime.test.ts#applies cubic overshoot, hold, per-component easing, scopes, and composition order

lottie.scope: A hold keyframe keeps the start value until the next key time, as in hold_keyframe.json.
conformanceTests: packages/format-lottie/src/lottie.test.ts#holds flat segments before the next key time

svg.scope: SVG discrete calcMode is not asserted as hold.

capabilities.summary: A composition definition and an instance record. Instances are not drawn a second time.
restrictions: The instance is validated. Pixels come from scene nodes, not from a second draw of the instance.
conformanceTests: packages/compiler/src/compiler.test.ts#compiles compositions, instances, scopes, and cubic easing

conformanceTests: packages/format-lottie/src/lottie.test.ts#inventories omitted constructs before lowering

svg.scope: SVG symbols and use are not this composition model.

lottie.scope: Static trim can be stored. No conformance test pins the operator values.

svg.scope: The SVG subset does not emit geometry operators.

capabilities.summary: Trim operators apply when a path is resolved.
restrictions: Static start/end/offset on geometryOperators. Animated trim.start/end/offset tracks require geometry.animatedTrim (0.5.0).

conformanceTests: packages/format-lottie/src/lottie.test.ts#imports animated trim as trim.start/end tracks

svg.scope: SVG stroke dash is not trim.

capabilities.summary: Keyframe tracks may drive trim.start, trim.end, and trim.offset on a path node.
restrictions: Values are normalised path fractions in [0, 1] for start/end. Offset wraps.
Requires a trim operator (or track-only override) on the same node for the window to apply.
conformanceTests: packages/runtime/src/runtime.test.ts#samples animated trim tracks over the composition
packages/compiler/src/compiler.test.ts#compiles animated trim channels with geometry.animatedTrim
packages/format-lottie/src/lottie.test.ts#imports animated trim as trim.start/end tracks

lottie.scope: Animated tm s/e/o lower to trim.start/end/offset tracks (0–1). Simultaneously mode only; individual trim mode is outside this claim.
conformanceTests: packages/format-lottie/src/lottie.test.ts#imports animated trim as trim.start/end tracks

svg.scope: SVG stroke dash is not trim.

capabilities.summary: A rectangle may carry a corner radius.
restrictions: Animated radius is outside this claim.

lottie.scope: Static rc.r can be stored. No conformance test pins the radius.

svg.scope: SVG rx and ry are not asserted.

capabilities.summary: A vec2 position key may carry spatial in and out tangents. Eased progress advances by arc length along the cubic (After Effects / lottie-web), not by the raw bezier parameter. Optional tangent Z participates in length only and is not drawn.
restrictions: Tangents are offsets from the key value. This is not a substitute for path morph.
Arc-length sampling uses a fixed polyline approximation (150 segments), matching lottie-web's defaultCurveSegments.
When tangent Z is present, chord length is measured in XYZ (lottie-web buildBezierData); only XY is returned.
conformanceTests: packages/schema/src/spatial.test.ts#samples spatial cubics by arc length
packages/schema/src/spatial.test.ts#includes Z in arc length like lottie-web when tangents carry depth
packages/runtime/src/runtime.test.ts#samples spatial position keys by arc length

lottie.scope: Spatial tangents on position tracks keep optional Z; runtime samples arc length in XYZ when Z is present.
conformanceTests: packages/format-lottie/src/lottie.test.ts#inventories omitted constructs before lowering
packages/format-lottie/src/lottie.test.ts#preserves spatial tangent Z for arc-length sampling
packages/runtime/src/runtime.test.ts#samples spatial position keys by arc length

svg.scope: SVG has no Bodymovin spatial tangents.

capabilities.summary: A fill may be a linear gradient with colour stops.

svg.scope: SVG gradient paints are not imported. No fixture test pins that diagnostic.

svg.scope: SVG gradient paints are not imported. No fixture test pins that diagnostic.

capabilities.summary: An image node draws a declared image resource when that resource is ready.

svg.scope: SVG image elements are not asserted.

lottie.scope: Lottie is not SMIL.

conformanceTests: packages/format-svg/src/svg.test.ts#imports time-based SMIL opacity and embedded CSS keyframes
